deals.headline: SEG gets new Utah NHL franchise with the Coyotes' hockey assets
deals.investor: Smith Entertainment Group (Ryan and Ashley Smith)
deals.summary: The NHL Board of Governors approved a new Utah franchise owned and controlled by SEG and the transfer of all the Coyotes' hockey assets (reserve list, players, picks, hockey operations) to it; the Coyotes franchise became inactive. Forbes gives the price paid as $1.2 billion.

deals.date_text: Approved by Salt Lake City Council, late September/October 2024
deals.evidence: The agreement gives Smith Entertainment Group the ability to seek up to $900 million in bonds
deals.headline: Salt Lake City backs up to $900M of bonds for Delta Center renovation
deals.summary: The city council authorised a partnership letting SEG seek up to $900 million in bonds for Delta Center renovations and a surrounding sports and entertainment district, repaid by a 0.5% sales tax increase over 30 years; SEG adds a $1-$3 ticket fee.

name: Utah Mammoth
notes: Revenue, operating income (EBITDA) and player expenses are Forbes estimates for 2024-25 (USD, net of revenue sharing and arena debt service); valuation is Forbes enterprise value calculated December 2025 (Forbes: owners Ryan and Ashley Smith, purchased 2024 for $1.2B; the $1.2B price on the acquisition deal is Forbes' figure, shown as '$1.2B'). Team played 2024-25 as Utah Hockey Club and became the Utah Mammoth in 2025. Arctos bought into the Jazz ownership group (SEG) in August 2022 per Sportico/KSL headlines, but no page read says Arctos holds part of the hockey team, so it is not listed. Delta Center (opened 1991): deltacenter.com says hockey capacity will be about 17,000 when renovations are complete, so the current capacity is left null; who owns the building is not stated on a page read (SEG runs and renovates it). Legal entity not found. Missing: capacity, stadium owner, legal entity, social, attendance, sponsors, honours (none).

ownership_summary: Owned and controlled by Smith Entertainment Group (SEG), led by Ryan and Ashley Smith, which also owns the NBA's Utah Jazz. The NHL created the franchise in April 2024 and moved the Arizona Coyotes' hockey assets to it; Forbes puts the price paid at $1.2 billion. No institutional investor is named as a holder of the hockey team on a page read.
